policy_used_for_diagnostic_only.note: Lateral/overlap/perimeter are declared trial policies, not physical laws. Explicit lateral/overlap values permit a bounded contact experiment, not a material-feasibility claim. The initial COM search radius does not change the 30 mm individual or 50 mm cumulative correction budget. The 5 mm minimum teddy/left-robot clearance is an engineering preflight allowance, not a physical law. Bottom clearance and lateral trial fraction are configurable; no compression is prescribed.

limits: This is a conservative geometrical envelope of frozen teddy sections at every actual rim height and the entire stated segment, not a physical cloth feasibility certificate.
A section may meet a local rim height only on part of the 3D lip; using all ordered projected rim vertices and its entire height interval is a conservative planning approximation.
Bag side-wall intersection/location is checked in a separate report; perimeter sufficiency cannot authorize side-wall teleportation.
Actual cloth and bear deformation require reobservation after every physical segment; no saved-state reset or geometry forcing.
